1946, Nay 15th
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed and handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.P.M. Cap.
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Huntington, Indiana
Ir. and Mrs. Joseph J. O'Donnell May 16th, 1946.
1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Illinois.
God bless you Mrs. O'Donnell, you and yours. Many thanks for the favor just received. Please God I'll have the holy Lass soon as requested.
Thank you also for the copy of the "Breeze ... " I had been figuering on getting a copy to send to our recently appointed General in Rome. ...... Indeed I quite enjoyed our mutual visits and entertainment a week ago. How quickly the time flies! I almost said"last Sunda:" Well, please God I'll be better acquainted the next time myself, and hope to do better.
I am surely pleased to know of the remarkable change in the condition and attitude of poor, dear old Mrs.O'Donnell. Thanks be to God again and our Blessed Mother Mary. I have no doubt that her cure is just another of the blessings in simple consequence of your active interest in our Bl. Mother - THE MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD. I am quite sure both Ray Garland and Louis Bemmicken would say the same thing if they knew about ... . We are so weak in setting limits to God's power and goodness.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.C.
